# Repeated discovery or verification can consume effort without adding evidence

## Situation and impact

Repeated discovery or verification can consume effort without adding evidence. This work serves the approved North Star goal of less consumer rework and faster correct development.

## Current slice and scope

The preceding slices and their direct callers, reviewer-run dry-run lifecycle, existing verification and task carriers.

Trace encountered friction, including a review dry-run that reserved its attempt directory and then refused the documented execution continuation before a reviewer started. Reproduce concrete causes; remove/merge or fix existing owners without adding a parallel runner. Follow consumer observations to select at least one duplicate operation for removal.

## Acceptance and verification

Same workload and acceptance before/after; actual removed repeated operation identified. Preserve refusal on genuinely existing live/reviewed attempts, input identity and publication safeguards. Capture any remaining bounded non-claims.
